key_points: GS testing its 200-day moving average as momentum shows signs of weakening.
Seeking Alpha notes the stock is approaching bear‑market territory, framing it as a potential buying opportunity.
In mid‑September 2026 GS issued a broad slate of callable medium‑term notes (2028‑2051) and redeemed existing notes at par, indicating active debt‑management activity.
GS warned that the AI‑driven boost to S&P 500 earnings may not be sustainable, suggesting caution on broader market outlook.
No earnings surprise or guidance change; Q2 2026 EPS is expected around $14.47 per TradingKey preview.
